node.title: MSCA Ecosystem Composition & Control — Ecosystem Cartography of Objective-Bound Architectures
node.summary: Contenido de la fuente: 2. Constituent MSCA versus composite MSCA · 2.1 Ecosystem composition of peer MSCAs · 2.2 Nested / higher-order composite MSCA.

relations: The later cartography distinguishes semantic compatibility from shared-resource dependence, a useful retrospective lens on xSeil’s state-dependent allocation.
xSeil no se convierte por esta comparación en una implementación distribuida de MSCA.
The historical allocation mechanism can inspire a later cartographic treatment of shared dependencies without being relabeled as an MSCA deployment.
Se propone una comparación posterior, no una prueba de influencia causal documentada para cada decisión de arquitectura.
